limitations: Missing returned poses count as failures at both existing accuracy limits.
Median/p90 errors are conditional on pose availability; use paired-frame analysis for changing availability.
External pose annotations are imperfect; unlabelled videos have no accuracy percentage.
Scores evaluate motion relative to initialization. They do not measure absolute initialization error or reconstructed-shape accuracy.
Timings exclude live segmentation and are additional method work, not independent end-to-end FPS.
The evaluated surface-motion error and angle use annotation poses without symmetry minimization.
Two deformable clips are negative controls, not evidence of rigid-object accuracy.
The full sweep measures accumulated changes including shared matching; it does not isolate each fix.
